android.desc:
Take control of your heart health with BP Tracker Pro, the ultimate offline Blood Pressure Tracker, BP Diary, and health monitor log. Keep your hypertension, pulse, weight, and blood sugar data 100% private with zero ads and no subscriptions.
Stop relying on paper logbooks or apps locked behind expensive monthly fees. BP Tracker Pro is a premium, all-in-one health journal that helps you record and analyze blood pressure, heart rate, blood glucose, weight, BMI, and SpO2. Pay once, own it for life, and generate professional PDF reports for your doctor in seconds.
🩸 ALL-IN-ONE HEALTH TRACKER
Go beyond just blood pressure. Enable optional tracking modules in Settings to log:
• Blood Pressure & Heart Rate (Pulse)
• Blood Glucose (Blood Sugar)
• Weight & BMI (Body Mass Index)
• Blood Oxygen (SpO2)
Everything is seamlessly organized in one unified dashboard with full support for both Metric and Imperial units.
🎙️ SMART VOICE LOGGING & UI
• Voice-to-Log: Simply tap the mic and speak (e.g., "120 over 80, pulse 65") to auto-fill your readings.
• Precision Gauges: Beautiful, 180-degree clinical gauges instantly show where your reading falls on the risk spectrum.
• Premium Design: Dark mode (Clinical Midnight) with smooth animations and tactile haptic feedback.
🧠 ADVANCED HEALTH INSIGHTS
More than a simple BP diary, BP Tracker Pro helps you understand long-term trends to manage hypertension.
• Advanced Metrics: Automatically calculates Mean Arterial Pressure (MAP) and Pulse Pressure.
• Pattern Recognition: Automatically highlights Morning Surges, White Coat Hypertension, and high variability.
• Vascular Index: A unique gamified score that helps track the overall stability of your blood pressure over 30 days.
📊 POWERFUL CHARTS & TRENDS
Visualize your progress with smooth, interactive charts.
• Sub-minute history sorting for rapid, hyper-accurate data logging.
• Time-in-Target donut charts showing Normal, Elevated, and High blood pressure distribution.
• Morning vs. Evening average comparisons.
💊 MEDICATION & CONTEXT LOGGING
• Quickly log medications using our built-in autocomplete database containing over 500 commonly prescribed cardiovascular and metabolic medications.
• Add clinical context to every reading, including Posture (Sitting/Standing) and Arm (Left/Right) to help your doctor understand your data.
🩺 AHA & ESC GUIDELINES
Personalize your experience by switching between American Heart Association (AHA) and European Society of Cardiol

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I built a Blood Pressure tracker because I was tired of the existing apps requiring cloud accounts, subscriptions, or selling health data to advertisers.

BP Tracker Pro is a "Class I Data Logger" built with Capacitor and Vanilla JS. It runs 100% offline on your device.

Key Features:
- Gorgeous panel to visually track your blood pressure readings
- Zero Cloud Sync: Data lives in a local JSON store (encrypted at rest by Android OS). You can bacjup
- PDF Reports: Generates clinical reports for doctors using jsPDF (client-side).
- Morning Surge Detection: Analyzes AM vs PM readings to flag stroke risks.
- Family Mode: Track multiple profiles (e.g., aging parents) from one dashboard.

Tech Stack:
- Vanilla JS + Vite (No React/Vue overhead)
- Capacitor v8 (Bridge to Native)
- Chart.js for trends

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.bloodpressureboss.pro
